flags.title: WVHRC 365-Day SOL — Longest State Civil Rights Window in Registry
flags.summary: West Virginia Human Rights Commission has a 365-day statute of limitations — the longest state civil rights filing window in the entire registry. WVHRC: 304-558-2616 / hrc.wv.gov.

flags.title: Opioid Epidemic — Highest Per-Capita Overdose Death Rate
flags.summary: West Virginia has the highest per-capita overdose death rate in the US. Substance use disorder affects employment, housing, and family stability. Screen for SUD at intake. WV DHHR: 304-558-0684 / dhhr.wv.gov. Crisis: 988. HELP4WV: 844-435-7498.

flags.title: Southern Coalfields — 20-35% Poverty, Digital Divide
flags.summary: Southern WV coalfield counties (McDowell, Mingo, Wyoming, Logan, Boone) have 20-35% poverty rates with severe digital divide. Many clients lack broadband access. Phone-first intake is essential. Mountain State Justice: 304-344-3144 / mountainstatejustice.org. Cabin Creek Health Center: 304-595-1070.

flags.title: 3-Year Wage SOL — WV Wage Payment and Collection Act
flags.summary: WV Wage Payment and Collection Act provides a 3-year statute of limitations for wage claims — longer than federal FLSA. Dual-file state and federal. WV DOL: 304-558-7890 / labor.wv.gov.

flags.title: No Federally Recognized Tribes — Mountain State Justice Covers Coalfields
flags.summary: West Virginia has no federally recognized tribes. For rural and coalfield communities, Mountain State Justice (304-344-3144 / mountainstatejustice.org) is the primary legal aid provider covering the most underserved areas.

flags.title: Involuntary Hold: West Virginia Emergency Involuntary Hospitalization
flags.message: WV involuntary psychiatric hold law: West Virginia Emergency Involuntary Hospitalization. Statutory authority: W. Va. Code § 27-5-2. Maximum initial hold duration: 48 hours. Legal standard: danger to self/others. A hearing must be held before the hold can be extended. The person has the right to counsel at the hearing.
action_items: Verify hold did not exceed 48 hours without court order
Confirm hearing was held within statutory timeframe
Check that patient rights notice was provided at admission
Request complete hold documentation from facility

flags.title: Psychiatric Patient Rights
flags.message: Psychiatric patients in WV retain fundamental rights during hospitalization: right to communicate with persons outside the facility, right to receive and send mail, right to access legal counsel, right to refuse treatment (with limited exceptions), right to informed consent, right to access medical records, and right to file grievances. These rights cannot be restricted as a condition of treatment.
action_items: Verify patient rights notice was provided and signed
Check whether any rights were restricted and if proper procedures were followed
Confirm access to legal counsel was not impeded

flags.title: Federal Restraint & Seclusion Limits
flags.message: Federal law (42 CFR § 482.13) sets strict limits on restraint and seclusion in WV: physician order required within 1 hour, face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour, continuous monitoring required, maximum 4 hours per order for adults (2 hours for ages 9-17, 1 hour for under 9), and restraint may only be used to protect the patient from harm — never as punishment, convenience, or retaliation.
action_items: Request restraint/seclusion logs for all episodes
Verify physician order was obtained within 1 hour
Check that face-to-face evaluation occurred within 1 hour
Verify restraint was not used as punishment or convenience
Check for injuries during restraint episodes
legal_references: CMS State Operations Manual Appendix A

flags.title: Involuntary Psychiatric Hold Statute
flags.message: This state has specific statutes governing involuntary psychiatric holds. Know the time limits, hearing rights, and appeal procedures before they expire.

flags.title: Mental Health Patient Bill of Rights
flags.message: This state has a Patient Bill of Rights for mental health facilities. Facilities must inform patients of these rights upon admission.
flags.statute: West Virginia Mental Health Patient Rights Act

flags.title: Discharge Planning Requirements
flags.message: This state requires facilities to create discharge plans with follow-up appointments, medication management, and community resource referrals.
flags.statute: West Virginia Mental Health Discharge Planning Standards
